get.summary:
WebSocket upgrade for a Terminal. The client supplies a one-use ticket token
in the query string plus an optional scrollback resume cursor. After replay,
the server streams live scrollback output and accepts binary input or JSON
control frames (`input`/`resize`/`signal`/`close`).

TerminalSignal.description:
Abstract signal a Terminal consumer may raise to the running shell.

The executor maps these to whatever the local execution backend supports.
It is intentionally not a raw POSIX signal value so the public contract
stays cross-platform: `ctrl_c` is an interrupt request and `terminate` is an
ungraceful kill request. Neither is required to be perfectly reliable on a
non-tty pipe backend; both are best-effort and the durable Terminal state
remains the source of truth.

TurnModelAttempt.description:
The most recent model attempt for this Turn's active Round, projected onto
`TurnSummary` so the UI can render the live retry counter
("Reconnecting (X): reason") even when the SSE event that announced it has
already been consumed. Absent when the Turn has had no attempts yet.

attempt.description:
1-based retry index surfaced to the UI (0 = the initial attempt, not a
retry). Matches the `attempt` field of `model.attempt_retrying` events.

detail.description: Normalized failure detail for a `failed` attempt; null otherwise.

The durable whole-Turn model exchange. Live direction remains a
stream concern and is intentionally not stored here.

download_tokens.description: Model output tokens for this Turn.

upload_tokens.description:
Non-cached model input tokens for this Turn, excluding the system and
developer prompt prefix.

automation_enabled.description: When set, changes whether Automation may use this PAT for pushes.

pat.description: When set, replaces the stored PAT. When omitted, the existing PAT is kept.

default_model_id.description: `null` clears the default model; omit to keep the current value.
